items.reason: Gap 1 describes concurrent duplicate deliveries both passing the check because the set is updated only after handler completion.
Gap 0 states that the deduplication key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header rather than the signed body identifier.
Gap 3 identifies that charge.refunded deliveries do not match the refund.created handler and therefore do not record refunds.
None of the gaps relies on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
